method.standing_queue: Consecutive upstream vehicles from the head, each speed <1 km/h and front-position gap <=15 m. Sensitivity count at <5 km/h retained separately. Vehicle length/type are not inferred.
method.cohort_match: Vehicle identity + pre-green lane/rank, continuous observations through crossing, connector source-lane mapping, no interleaved departures or tied/reversed ranks.
method.startup_excess: C4 - green_onset - 4 * ((C8-C4)/4), with native one-second onset and crossing intervals; never first-cross lag.
method.minimum: At least 8 initial standing contiguous vehicles and 8 retained ranked departures. This is an audit screen, not proof of saturated flow.
method.capacity: No capacity rescaling, demand normalization, or fitted controller parameter.
